team.membersHint: Within a task, members collaborate or switch according to the routing strategy.
team.strategyHint: How the team collaborates inside a conversation.
team.leadHint: In dispatch mode this expert acts as the coordinator, assigns tasks to members and aggregates (counted in the team size).
team.rolesHint: Define a role for each expert (including the lead); used when dispatching/aggregating.

strategy.manualDesc: Manually switch member personas within a task
strategy.autoDesc: Main agent auto-delegates to members in parallel and aggregates
strategy.workflowDesc: Code-defined pipeline executed step by step (analyze → implement → review)

team.workflowReadonlyHint: The pipeline is generated in code; visual editing is not available yet.
team.builtinReadonlyHint: Built-in example teams are read-only. Duplicate to customize.

skill.contentHint: Editing and saving updates the skill package file; /invoke follows these instructions.

connector.reservedBody: This connector is registered and tagged but not yet injected into agents. Activation is staged by type: MCP / file system available now, HTTP API / data source in development. Zero migration on activation.
connector.connectedBody: Enabled connector capabilities are injected into bound experts (MCP tools as customTools); the binding takes effect immediately.
connector.customNote: {{type}} type is registration-only; runtime injection comes later; config is free-form JSON.
connector.boundHint: Declares which experts can use this connector; when MCP is enabled its tools are injected into these experts.
connector.jsonTransportStdio: no url → STDIO (local process, managed install to ~/EveryBuddy/mcp-servers/)
connector.jsonHintSuffix: . After setting env vars like GITHUB_TOKEN, "Test connection" will succeed.

reservedModal.subAgentDesc: Main agent orchestrates sub-agents: dispatches subtasks, runs in parallel, aggregates results.
reservedModal.workflowDesc: Visual node orchestration of multi-agent flows: a directed-graph execution of requirements → design → code → review.
reservedModal.noteTitle: This capability is reserved for a future release.
reservedModal.noteBody: This round the team tab only ships "member registration + manual switching". Agent team orchestration and Workflow orchestration are future directions; schema fields are already reserved, zero migration on activation.

confirm.deleteTaskTempDesc:
This will delete task "{{title}}" and all of its session history.
Session files on disk (under ~/EveryBuddy/sessions) and the temporary working directory will also be removed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteTaskWsDesc:
This will delete task "{{title}}" and all of its session history.
Session files on disk (under ~/EveryBuddy/sessions) will also be removed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.removeWorkspaceDesc:
This will remove workspace "{{name}}":
· The {{num}} task(s) under it and their session history will be deleted;
· The workspace directory itself stays on disk and won't be deleted.
This cannot be undone.
